definitions.gloss: to prevent; to stop; to check
definitions.explanation: To take measures to stop something harmful or undesirable from occurring. More formal than {防|ふせ}ぐ, often used in institutional, legal, and policy contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{防止|ぼうし}する。
⟦{再発|さいはつ}{防止|ぼうし}→再発防止：20419_saihatsuboushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{努|つと}めます→努める：17701_tsutomeru⟧。
examples.english: We will make efforts to prevent a recurrence.

examples.japanese: ⟦{情報|じょうほう}{漏洩|ろうえい}→情報漏洩：19198_jouhourouei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{防止|ぼうし}する⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Measures to prevent information leaks are necessary.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal word used heavily in official documents, laws, regulations, and business contexts. The noun form ⟦{防止|ぼうし}→防止：14571_boushi⟧ frequently appears in compound terms.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦{防止|ぼうし}→防止：14571_boushi⟧ (accident prevention)
- ⟦{再発|さいはつ}{防止|ぼうし}→再発防止：20419_saihatsuboushi⟧ (recurrence prevention)
- ⟦{犯罪|はんざい}→犯罪：03569_hanzai⟧⟦{防止|ぼうし}→防止：14571_boushi⟧ (crime prevention)
- ⟦{汚染|おせん}→汚染：02595_osen⟧⟦{防止|ぼうし}→防止：14571_boushi⟧ (pollution prevention)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{予防|よぼう}する→予防する：17341_yobousuru⟧: to prevent — focuses on advance precaution, especially for health
- ⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧: to prevent, to defend — everyday verb, broader usage
